slides.text: 5 questions to ask before you switch programmes again

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text: 1. have you run it long enough to see a trend?

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text: 2. can you say what you lifted on each exercise last session?

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text: 3. do you know what you're aiming for today?

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text: 4. are you doing every session it asks for, or skipping the ones you don't like?

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text: 5. are you actually stuck, or just bored?
can't answer 2 and 3? that's a tracking problem. EARND shows last session and today's target on every exercise.
